διαβαίνω: to cross (a river, etc.); to stand with feet apart
διαδιδράσκω: to run off, get away, escape
μεταβαίνω: to pass over from one place to another
παρεκβαίνω: to step out aside from, deviate from
πελάζω: to approach, come near, draw near
προβαίνω: to step on, step forward, advance
συγκαταβαίνω: to go or come down with
τλάω: to take upon oneself, to bear, suffer, undergo
φθάνω: to come or do first, before others
ἀναβαίνω: to go up, mount, to go up to
ἐκδιδράσκω: to run out from, run away, escape
ὑπερκαταβαίνω: to get down over, get quite over
